note: CSV time labels are retained as exported; they do not establish USB bit timing. Each complete 0,1,2,3 cycle contains eight samples per page and is coherent because the observer commits its 128-bit mailbox only before page 0. There is no snapshot sequence or freshness flag: a capture need not contain a newly acknowledged snapshot, and repeated page cycles may show the same previous snapshot. Before any 60 MHz acknowledgement, payload pages are zero. The clock count is a separate 10 ms measurement; zero persists after a full stopped-clock window. This is not a complete ULPI or USB protocol trace.
